newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-VILLA AGREE TO MCGRATH'S TRANSFER REQUEST.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VILLA AGREE TO MCGRATH'S TRANSFER REQUEST.

text.p: Aston Villa have accepted a formal transfer request from Republic of Ireland defender Paul McGrath and said on Wednesday he could leave as soon as they received an acceptable offer.
"I've agreed to his transfer request," Villa manager Brian Little said. "When people ask to leave I've normally made sure that I've been able to move them on."
"In any case, in those circumstances it is very difficult to think about picking him to play. I am open to offers for Paul, although, as yet, nobody has enquired."
Villa are asking 200,000 pounds ($310,000) for McGrath, capped 82 times by his ccountry, to cover his pre-season signing-on fee and subsequent wages.

McGrath, who has been relegated to the substitute's bench this season after more than 250 league games for Villa, claims the League Cup holders are preventing him moving to another club by demanding a fee for him.
In an interview with a local newspaper at the weekend he said Villa's insistence on a 200,000 pound fee for a 36-year-old at the end of his career "was nothing short of disgraceful".
Midlands rivals Coventry approached Villa regarding a possible transfer deal a fortnight ago but were put off by the asking price.
